fields.showStreamEntries: Show Added Time Entries in Stream

tooltips.targetEntityType: The existing queue or event-based entity this instance measures. No fields are added to it.
tooltips.identifierField: Select the target field users recognize as the ticket, task, or work reference.
tooltips.nameField: Select the target record's human-readable title for package headers, reports, and exports. Work Block names describe the individual planned activities.
tooltips.statusField: Select the target entity's enum status field. Workflow status choices are populated from it.
tooltips.resourceField: Select an existing User or Users relationship representing assigned resources.
tooltips.accountField: Optionally select an existing Account relationship for reporting snapshots.
tooltips.contactField: Optionally select an existing Contact relationship for reporting snapshots.
tooltips.inProgressStatus: The existing target status applied when work is reported in.
tooltips.completedStatusList: Existing target statuses treated as completed and ready for time-entry reconciliation.
tooltips.addTimeLogsTargetStatus: Optional mirror only. Leave blank to keep Add Time Logs solely in the extension's Billing queue.
tooltips.readyForBillingTargetStatus: Optional mirror only. Leave blank to keep Ready for Billing solely in the extension's Billing queue.
tooltips.invoicedTargetStatus: Optional mirror only. Leave blank to keep Invoiced solely in the extension's Billing queue.
tooltips.eligibilityCriteria: Optional advanced AND-combined rules. Enter a JSON array of objects using field, operator, and value keys.
tooltips.defaultWorkBlockIds: Select the Work Blocks added by default and arrange their planning order. Lower positions are added first.
